integrity: Finite computations reconstructed from standalone program; proof also uses standard Armstrong, Hurewicz, and Whitehead theorems. The result has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy type only for the full 20-element automorphism quotient of the ordinary matching complex of C5 square K2; no statement for other prism widths, subgroup quotients, or an equivariant splitting. Source date identifies the earliest verified pre-2016 matching-complex grid direction, not the date of the new result.
title: The full-symmetry quotient of the pentagonal-prism matching complex is a three-sphere
